evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies getblocktemplate caching in src/rpc/mining.cpp and src/node/block_template_manager.cpp.
rationale: Encapsulates template caching logic into BlockTemplateManager to eliminate process-scoped global statics. This fixes a test-environment lifetime issue where cached raw CBlockIndex pointers could outlive the ChainstateManager across node contexts, adds unit test coverage, and unblocks further global state removal under #33758.
